name: List games
description: Every registered game with its current season. Kept lean deliberately: the shell calls this on every route, and GET /v1/games/{game} is what a page asks for once it knows which game it is showing.

input.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', g.slug, 'name', g.name, 'season', (SELECT season_json(s) FROM current_season(g.id) s)) ORDER BY g.name), '[]'::json) AS body FROM games g
